body:
The darkness seemed to grow thicker around me as I stepped off the platform, my footsteps echoing through the empty station. The air was thick with anticipation and fear, making every breath difficult. My heart pounded so loudly in my chest that I thought someone might hear it from the tracks beyond. 

I turned towards the window, fingers trembling as they gripped the handle. But then something caught my eye—a flicker of light glinting against a distant building on the horizon. It was too close, but perhaps there was still time if I acted quickly enough.

Next: put real distance between myself and it.
